summary: First iteration. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (health, walls CRUD with id/404 handling, Gemini /api/analyze reading F1-14402 at 320x301x14). Found and FIXED critical bug: FastAPI was serializing Wall responses with _id alias instead of id (breaking frontend w.id usage) - added response_model_by_alias=False to the 3 wall endpoints. Frontend: all requested flows verified at 390x844 - home screen, manual entry 120cm wall produces cut-group-19 (course 1: 50+50+20->19), save wall shows in Historia + Nowa recent list, delete via confirm-delete-button works, settings tolerance=98 saved -> 100cm wall shows 'Moduł bloczka: 49 cm (tol. 98/100)' as expected, add-opening with 100x200 opening on 300x250 wall produces 10 courses with split segments and diagram showing opening. Camera/gallery buttons present. Polish UI renders correctly.
action_items: All requested features verified working. No remaining issues.

Note: Save/toast overlay at bottom briefly obstructs bottom tab bar (~3s). Users must wait or dismiss toast before tapping tabs. Minor UX only - consider auto-hide shorter or route toast above tab bar.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Wall endpoints returned '_id' instead of 'id'. FastAPI default response_model_by_alias was emitting the alias; explicitly set response_model_by_alias=False on POST/GET/GET-id endpoints in /app/backend/server.py.
Server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in modern FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan context manager (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates and tears down a TEST_WALL_F1-14402 wall. Frontend testing created 1 wall ('Ściana' 120x50) and deleted it during flow verification. A pre-existing TEST_DEBUG wall from debugging curl remains in DB (not auto-cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Field testID on text inputs is placed directly on the <TextInput>, so use `page.fill('[data-testid="edit-length"]', '120')` (no nested input selector). Bottom tab testIDs are tab-new/tab-history/tab-settings. Toast appears at bottom and briefly blocks tab bar; wait 3s after save/reset before clicking a tab. Backend wall endpoints now return 'id' (string). Gemini call takes ~5-8 seconds.
rca_of_issue: Bug: POST/GET /api/walls returned '_id' instead of 'id'. RCA: Wall model inherits BaseDocument with `id: Optional[PyObjectId] = Field(alias='_id')`. FastAPI serialized responses using by_alias=True (current default behavior with aliased fields). Frontend code (index.tsx, result.tsx) accesses w.id, which would be undefined, breaking React keys and navigation params. Fix: set response_model_by_alias=False on wall endpoints so pydantic emits the field name 'id'. Verified via pytest asserts and curl.
